knitr::opts_chunk$set(error=FALSE)
if (!exists(".version")) {
    .version <- package_version("1.0")

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("# Bumpy atomic array (", as.character(.version), ")", sep="")
```

## Overview

The `bumpy_atomic_array` specification describes an on-disk representation of a **bumpy atomic array**.
This is a N-dimensional array where each entry is an atomic vector of the same type.
It is based on the `BumpyMatrix` subclasses for atomic vectors, as implemented in the [**BumpyMatrix** Bioconductor package](https://bioconductor.org/packages/BumpyMatrix).

Here, the central idea is to store a single **atomic vector** consisting of the concatenation of all entries of the **bumpy atomic array**.
Each entry of the **bumpy atomic array** is defined as a contiguous slice into this concatenated **atomic vector**.
This avoids the storage overhead of multiple **atomic vector** objects, which may be significant if each object is very small.

## Object metadata

The `OBJECT` file should contain a `bumpy_atomic_array` property, itself a JSON object with the following properties:

- `version`, a string specifying the version of the `bumpy_atomic_array` format.
```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
cat("  This should be set to \"", as.character(.version), "\".", sep="")
```

## Directory structure

### Contents

The directory should contain:

- `OBJECT`, a JSON file as described above.
- `partitions.h5`, a HDF5 file.
- `concatenated/`, a subdirectory.

### `partitions.h5`

```{r, results="asis", echo=FALSE}
payload <- readLines("bumpy_array_partitions.md")
cat(payload, sep="\n")
```

### `concatenated/`

The `concatenated/` subdirectory contains a child object of the [`atomic_vector`](../atomic_vector) type.
The height of this child object should be equal to the sum of lengths in the `bumpy_atomic_array/lengths` dataset of the `partitions.h5` file.
This child object represents the concatenation of all of the **atomic vector** objects in the **bumpy atomic array**.

Recall that each entry of the **bumpy atomic array** is represented by an entry of the `bumpy_atomic_array/lengths` dataset in `partitions.h5`.
To construct the **atomic vector** corresponding to the $i$-th entry of the `bumpy_atomic_array/lengths` dataset,
we take the slice $[s_i, s_i + l_i)$ of the `concatenated/` object.  
$l_i$ is defined as the $i$-th entry of the `bumpy_atomic_array/lengths` dataset.
$s_i$ is defined as the sum of $l_j$ for all $j < i$, or zero if $i = 0$.

## Height

The height of the **bumpy atomic array** is defined as the extent of the first dimension, as specified in the `bumpy_atomic_array/dimensions` dataset of `partitions.h5`.

## Dimensions

The dimensions of the **bumpy atomic array** are taken from the `bumpy_atomic_array/dimensions` dataset of `partitions.h5`.
